I have everything needed. All counts verified. Writing the report.

# 01 — Canonical Seam Inventory: `RynthCoreHost` Host Contract

**Sources read in full:** `RynthCore.PluginSdk/RynthCoreHost.cs` (1,450 lines, ABI v66) and `RynthCore.PluginSdk/RynthCoreApiNative.cs` (123 lines). Every row cites `Host.cs:N` (RynthCoreHost.cs) or `Api.cs:N` (RynthCoreApiNative.cs). Counts were derived mechanically (ripgrep), not estimated.

| Metric | Value | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Native ABI struct fields (`RynthCoreApiNative`) | **112** | 108 `IntPtr …Fn` function pointers + `Version` (uint) + 3 handle `IntPtr` (`ImGuiContext`,`D3DDevice`,`GameHwnd`) — Api.cs:9-121 |
| Function pointers (`…Fn`) | **108** | Api.cs (`rg 'public IntPtr \w+Fn;'` = 108) |
| `RynthCoreHost` public members (excl. ctor) | **217** | 1 const + 5 properties + 103 `Has*` probes + 108 functional methods |
| — Functional methods | **108** | invoke a native fn or compose (incl. `HasAppraisalData(uint)` which is a *method*, not a probe) |
| — Properties (non-probe) | **5** | `Version`,`ImGuiContext`,`D3DDevice`,`GameHwnd`,`CanCastNow` (Host.cs:17-20, 663) |
| — `Has*` capability probes | **103** | parameterless `public bool Has… => _api.…Fn != IntPtr.Zero` (Host.cs; 104 `Has`-named members minus the 1 method `HasAppraisalData`) |
| `Has*` inline-guard call sites in RynthAi (est. from task) | 344 | (external; not in these two files) |
| **Api function pointers with NO host wrapper** | **0** | see §"Unwrapped pointers" — every one of the 108 `…Fn` is invoked by exactly one wrapper; all 4 non-fn fields surface as properties |

| Rows marked **DROP** (UI-overlay/render, headless-irrelevant) | **16** | see §"DROP" |

**ABI version:** `CurrentApiVersion = 66` (Host.cs:8). Native table declares append-at-end fields "v62+" from `GiveObjectToFn` onward (Api.cs:114-121). Non-version-gated members are marked **base** (present in the ≤v49 baseline table; no `Version >=` guard in code).

**Combat-mode encoding** (referenced by several rows): `1=NonCombat 2=Melee 4=Missile 8=Magic` (Host.cs:160).

## Unwrapped Api function pointers: **NONE**

Every one of the 108 `…Fn` pointers in `RynthCoreApiNative` is invoked by exactly one `RynthCoreHost` wrapper (verified: for each field, exactly one line in Host.cs contains both `delegate* unmanaged` and `_api.<Field>`). The 4 non-function fields all surface as properties: `Version`→`Version` (Host.cs:17), `ImGuiContext`→`ImGuiContext` (18), `D3DDevice`→`D3DDevice` (19), `GameHwnd`→`GameHwnd` (20). **The host wrapper is a total 1:1 cover of the native ABI table** — there is no hidden native surface a web reimplementation could miss, and no wrapper that lacks a backing pointer.

Two naming nuances a re-implementer must not trip on:
- `HasAppraisalDataFn` (Api.cs:91) backs a **method** `HasAppraisalData(uint)` (Host.cs:612), whose *probe* is the doubly-prefixed `HasHasAppraisalData` (Host.cs:60).
- `GetCastBusyStateFn` (Api.cs:110) is consumed by both the method `GetCastBusyState()` and the derived property `CanCastNow` (Host.cs:663) — the only property that composes over another method rather than reading a field.

## Category totals

| Category | Rows | of which DROP | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| combat-action | 13 | 0 | incl. `CanCastNow` prop; gates (`GetBusyState`,`GetCastBusyState`,`GetUseDoneSeq`) central to the poll-vs-async risk |
| movement-motion | 15 | 0 | jump family spans v51/v52; rest base |
| object-read | 24 | 0 | `GetObjectPalettes` (v50) is appearance-only, low headless value |
| property-read | 19 | 0 | STypeInt/Bool/Double/Quad/String/DID + skills/attrs/vitals/enchantments |
| inventory-action | 13 | 0 | opcodes 0x19/0x55/0x1A + give F7B1; salvage panel trio |
| chat | 2 | 0 | `WriteToChat`, `InvokeChatParser` |
| lifecycle-meta | 8 | 0 | 2 retail-hook probes are no-ops on web |
| other / cross-plugin | 3 | 0 | v64/v66 JSON brokers; single-bot web makes these low value |
| UI-overlay / rendering | 16 | **16** | Nav3D×5, WorldToScreen, ViewportSize, RadarRect, 4× suppression, SetFpsLimit, ImGui/D3D/HWND handles |
| fellowship-trade | 0 | 0 | **No dedicated fellowship/trade surface exists.** The only give/trade primitive is `GiveObjectTo` (counted under inventory-action) |
| **TOTAL** | **113** | **16** | 108 methods + 5 properties |

**Net headless target surface = 113 − 16 DROP = 97 members** to reimplement against holtburger-web (of which 2 lifecycle probes + 3 cross-plugin brokers + `GetObjectPalettes` are ⚠️ low-value / likely stubbable, leaving ~91 that a web host must genuinely satisfy for RynthAi to run headless).

## Version-gate reference (for host-capability planning)

| ABI | Members gated at this version |
|---|---|
| base (≤49, ungated) | 90 of 108 methods + all 5 props except none gated |
| v50 | GetObjectPalettes |
| v51 | CommenceJump, DoJump |
| v52 | LaunchJumpWithMotion |
| v53 | TryGetRadarRect *(DROP)* |
| v54 | SetRadarSuppressed *(DROP)* |
| v55 | SetChatSuppressed *(DROP)* |
| v56 | SetPowerbarSuppressed *(DROP)* |
| v61 | Nav3DAddRingEx *(DROP)* |
| v62 | GiveObjectTo |
| v63 | GetUseDoneSeq |
| v64 | GetEngineStatusJson, GetPluginSnapshotJson, SendPluginCommand |
| v65 | TryGetObjectDataIdProperty |
| v66 | GetPluginExportJson |

Of the 16 version-gated members, 6 are DROP (all render/UI). A web host declaring `Version = 66` and populating the 91 keep-surface pointers (leaving DROP + low-value pointers `IntPtr.Zero`) is a valid, RynthAi-tolerated target: the 103 `Has*` probes + 344 external guard sites let unimplemented entries fail closed.
